message.content:
Here’s a mix of classic, modern, and cult‑favorite horror films you might enjoy:

| # | Title | Year | Director | Why it’s worth watching |
|---|-------|------|----------|------------------------|
| 1 | **The Shining** | 1980 | Stanley Kubrick | A masterclass in psychological dread and iconic imagery. |
| 2 | **Hereditary** | 2018 | Ari Aster | A chilling family saga with bone‑shaking performances. |
| 3 | **Get Out** | 2017 | Jordan Peele | Horror meets sharp social commentary—smart, scary, and unforgettable. |
| 4 | **A Quiet Place** | 2018 | John Krasinski | Silence is the main weapon; tension builds with every footstep. |
| 5 | **Midsommar** | 2019 | Ari Aster | A daylight nightmare that turns the usual horror tropes on their head. |
| 6 | **It Follows** | 2014 | David Robert Mitchell | An eerie, relentless stalker that feels both ancient and contemporary. |
| 7 | **The Babadook** | 2014 | Jennifer Kent | Psychological terror wrapped in a mother‑daughter story. |
| 8 | **The Conjuring** | 2013 | James Wan | A well‑crafted supernatural thriller that sparked a franchise. |
| 9 | **Suspiria (1977)** | 1977 | Dario Argento | A visually stunning, haunting masterpiece of Italian giallo. |
|10 | **The Witch** | 2015 | Robert Eggers | A slow‑burning, atmospheric horror set in Puritan New England. |

Feel free to pick based on your mood—whether you want a psychological thriller, supernatural scare, or something that blends horror with social critique. Enjoy the chills!
